visual_logic.surface_detail: Hydrodynamic skin with 'Azure Blue' dorsal tones and 'Creamy White' countershading. Features very fine, diamond-shaped scales that create a subtle shimmering texture under direct light.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the 'hypocercal' tail fluke (the tail bends down into a powerful paddle) and the large, rounded flippers used for sharp steering.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Intelligent and alert; soulful amber eyes with a focused predatory gaze.

environment.water: Crystal-clear turquoise water over a high-albedo 'Cream White' chalk floor.
environment.biota: Darting through a school of silvery 'Gillicus' fish.

visual_logic.pose: An aggressive, high-speed banking turn; the body is tilted 45 degrees to showcase the surface area of the flippers and the power of the tail fluke.
